concept.title: Support to lose weight and eat healthily
concept.shortdesc: As someone who wants to lose weight, I need a programme or group, so that I can change my habits with support.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-031). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Often a mix of activity and food advice.
A good result: Programmes and groups, with cost, referral routes and what they involve.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
